columns.name: Sort
columns.description: Allows for sorting the points in the order they occur on the course.

columns.name: Boundaries - ZIP Codes
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'Boundaries - ZIP Codes' (rpca-8um6) the point in column 'point' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.
